title: Extending the WILDS Benchmark for Unsupervised Adaptation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy for toxicity classification on text comments mentioning male or female demographic identities (CivilComments-wilds dataset).
Evaluating worst-group accuracy for toxicity classification on text comments mentioning Black or White demographic identities (CivilComments-wilds dataset).
Evaluating worst-group accuracy for toxicity classification on text comments mentioning Christian, Muslim, or other religious identities (CivilComments-wilds dataset).
Evaluating worst-group accuracy for toxicity classification on text comments mentioning LGBTQ identities (CivilComments-wilds dataset).

Measuring worst-region accuracy (Africa, Americas, Oceania, Asia, Europe) for satellite land use classification (FMoW-wilds), and evaluating performance disparities between urban and rural subpopulations for poverty mapping (PovertyMap-wilds).
Evaluating predictive performance across different countries and rural versus urban settings to measure representation and accuracy disparities in poverty mapping (PovertyMap-wilds).
Measuring 10th percentile user accuracy in a product review sentiment classification task to evaluate disparate model performance on tail subpopulations of reviewers (Amazon-wilds).
